name: This is Not a Place of Honor
source:
In the year 21XX, defunct nuclear power plants and waste sites dot the continent. Four people riddled with debts they can't pay off in this lifetime enter one that holds the promise of an unthinkable amount of valuables.

[From [url=https://plagueofcrows.itch.io/this-is-not-a-place-of-honor]Itch.io[/url]]
